messages:
samir: Kicking off intake for Inkling-5B. Need prioritization, quant experiments, and a rollout checklist covering Hosted / Dedicated / Private. TL;DR: promising quality vs cost but some perf outliers on long context. :eyes:

maria: Thanks — can you drop the eval summary and the biggest risks?

alex.k: Quick dump from the eval pipeline (small batch):
```
model: inkling-5b-v0
fp32 baseline: perplexity 12.4, avg_latency(128 tok) = 220ms/token on A100-80GB
int8 (PTQ): perplexity 12.9 (+4%), avg_latency = 140ms/token, memory ~18GB
int4 (GPTQ): perplexity 13.6 (+9.5%), avg_latency = 95ms/token, memory ~11GB
quality: hit-rate on our intent eval set = 92% (baseline 94%)
```
main risks: occasional 2x latency spikes at seq_len>2048 (KV cache fallback?), and a subtle hallucination pattern on code-gen prompts.

jen: Do we have A/B evals vs current production model? What's the user-facing degradation threshold?

alex.k: A/B we ran on 8k examples: avg BLEU/ROUGE down ~1.4 points for int8, more for int4. We set guard rails: if any top-level metric drops >3% we block. That was agreed in product SLAs.

den nis: Could those latency spikes be an attention kernel fallback on T4s? Which HW did you test?

alex.k: Primary infra: A100 and T4 spot for cost sims. Spikes were observed on T4-lined hosts when sequence >2048; root cause appears to be mixed-precision matmul path that falls back to slower kernel for sequence chunking. Repro steps in the repo: `eng-ml/bench/inkling/seq_spike_repro.ipynb`

samir: For prioritization, propose: 1) fix the fallback or add seq_len heuristic to route long contexts to A100 dedicated pool, 2) run a 48h smoke on Hosted with 5% traffic, int8 only, 3) parallel quantization sweep (separate PR for int8 calibration and GPTQ int4)

maria: Sounds good. Also need private deployment checklist (customer CISO asked about KMS + offline audit). Add a step for HSM integration testing.

alex.k: Draft rollout canary config (suggested):
```json
{
  "canary": {
    "traffic_percent": 5,
    "duration": "48h",
    "fallback": "inkling-5b-v0->inkling-5b-v0-fp32",
    "slo_filters": ["p50_latency<200ms","error_rate<0.5%","quality_regressions<3%"]
  }
}
```
Use the CLI: `rwctl rollout create --model inkling-5b-v0 --canary-config canary.json`

jen: For Dedicated customers we need a playbook: pinned version + no auto-quantize by default, but provide a recommended quant profile. Product asked to ship int8 profile as opt-in.

dennis: Private: require offline package test plan. Steps: generate model bundle, run `verify_bundle.sh` (includes KMS decrypt, hash checks), then run local eval harness (same eval dataset), and sign artifact. Also require an enclave test for customers using HSM.

deploy-bot: Reminder: maintenance window tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC. Any planned canaries during that slot will be paused.

samir: Noted — we'll avoid deploy window. Action items: @alex.k to fix kernel fallback or add routing heuristic (ETA 3d), @maria to own hosted smoke + quality monitor (ETA 5d), @dennis to draft private/HSM test checklist (ETA 7d), @jen to align product messaging and opt-in int8 profile (ETA 4d).

alex.k: Uploading a minimal repro + perf trace: https://redwood-internal.s3/inkling/1887654321/perf_trace.tar.gz

maria: We'll create an eval alert: if eval_narrow_intent_drop > 2% for two consecutive runs, auto-abort rollout and rollback to previous.

sre-bot: Note: Canary policy requires at least 3 healthy replicas in each region for canary traffic. Current dedicated pool has 2 in eu-west-1. Recommend provisioning one more. :warning:

samir: Good catch. @dennis can you provision extra replica for canary in eu-west-1?

den nis: On it, will queue infra request. ETA 24h.

jen: Any objections to shipping int8 to Hosted canary only and hold int4 behind a gated beta?

maria: No objections. Int4 needs more eval on code-gen hallucinations.

alex.k: I'll finalize quant calibration parameters and push the PR with perf numbers and unit tests. Also adding a short regression test against our prompt set.

samir: Nice. Last note: include rollback playbook in the rollout PR with clear commands: `rwctl rollout rollback --id <canary-id>` and runbook steps. Keep the canary short and instrumented. :shipit:
